test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If A's salary is 51% more than that of B, then by what percentage is B's salary less than that of A (correct to two decimal places)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If **A** is **r%** more than **B**, then **B** is less than **A** by [r / (100 + r)] × 100%.

Required percentage = [51 / (100 + 51)] × 100

⇒ 5100 ÷ 151 ≈ 33.77%

**∴ The correct answer is 33.77%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdc251cd891ee50f563c0d1a10e40ef57f3fb11a70368515d691f272019da7e4.png] 

**Given:**

Let **B's salary** = 100

**A's salary** is 51% more than **B**.

⇒ **A's salary** = 100 + 51% of 100 = 100 + 51 = 151

**Calculations:**

Difference between **A** and **B** = 151 − 100 = 51

Percentage by which **B** is less than **A** = (Difference / **A's salary**) × 100

⇒ Required % = (51 / 151) × 100

⇒ Required % = 5100 / 151

⇒ Required % = 33.7748...

Rounding to two decimal places, we get 33.77%.

**∴ The correct answer is 33.77%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change Comparison

When comparing two quantities, if A is x% more than B, then B is [x / (100 + x)] × 100% less than A.

Base Change Rule

Percentage is always calculated relative to the **base value**. When finding 'less than A', **A's value** becomes the denominator.

Inverse Case

If A is x% less than B, then B is [x / (100 − x)] × 100% more than A.</p
